title: TypeSafe AI 发布 Jev：只返回类型化概率、不吐文本的决策模型
summary: TypeSafe AI（前 OpenAI 研究员 Diogo Almeida 创办）推出只输出类型化概率、不生成文本的决策模型 Jev，Vercel AI Gateway 上线一天即覆盖近 13% 付费团队，成为本时段最热的模型侧信号。
summary_en: The note reports that TypeSafe AI, founded by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, has launched Jev, a decision model designed to return only typed probabilities rather than generate text. It also claims that, within one day of appearing on Vercel’s AI Gateway, Jev reached nearly 13% of paying teams, making it the period’s hottest model-side signal.
body:
TypeSafe AI（前 OpenAI 研究员 Diogo Almeida 创办）推出只输出类型化概率、不生成文本的决策模型 Jev，Vercel AI Gateway 上线一天即覆盖近 13% 付费团队，成为本时段最热的模型侧信号。
